Repository discovery: gh repo list VULUxOMID --limit 50 returned qa-reports, subject-photo, VuluGOv6, Vulu-v2.5, buyrobux, Vulu-v2.1. Vulu-v2.5 main and Vulu-v2.1 master contain Firebase rules but both .firebaserc files target vulugo, not vulu-ebcd6. VuluGOv6 has no firebase.json/firestore.rules/storage.rules in its HEAD tree. No matching app repository established; no unrelated repo cloned to ~/src/vulu. Firebase Studio provenance is not established.
Console fallback: the vulu-ebcd6 Firestore Rules page reports that the project does not exist or the current account lacks permission to list apps. No rules could be read; no emulator initialized against invented rules.
